_note: I049: note corrections found while writing docs/code/combat-damage-and-enemy-records.md. (1) ApplySwordHit, DetectHitSourceCollisions and mc_obj_floor_spikes_check_026F36 said 'knocked back' / 'knock-back'; no routine of engine_combat_hits.asm and not Cop39_DamagePlayer writes $00-$06 of a victim (OQ-I047-6), a hit only sets the hit stun, freezes the target or redirects it to RunEnemyDeath. (2) AddExp named engine_actor_scheduler_and_sprites as the home of the two kill paths; they are KillTarget and KillOrSpareProjectileTarget in engine_combat_hits.asm (the block note of lib_player_helpers already says so). (3) The MetaGrassValley note listed $2E as a second Purple Bird; the row's script is gv_enemy_monster_blocks_0FB04F (the Monster Blocks, HP 4, EXP word 3: the bestiary says 2 EXP, OQ-I049-1). (4) The scheduler block note listed $16 bits $0100 and $0200 as unexplained; the combat masks ($0D00 sources, $EEC0 targets, $25C0 contact) define them (OQ-I005-14 answered for those two). (5) The St. Elles coast block note called the Lightning Pyramid damage inferred; ApplyProjectileHit reads the $30 byte first and $FF skips the class and boss tests.
